newsitem.title: UK: Swiss Re names new health and life board.
newsitem.headline: Swiss Re names new health and life board.

text.p: Swiss Re has named the 10 strong board of its new life and health division, formed in the wake of the group's acquisition of M&G Re, which was completed in early December.
The board appointments were one of the first steps in the integration of M&G with parts of Swiss Re, a spokeswoman told Reuters. Regional and functional appointments are expected to be made soon.
John Coomber has taken over as head of the new life and health division, replacing former M&G chief executive John Engestrom who has moved to head up Liberty Re.
Jeff Hart and Peter Patterson lead the business units in the U.S., Canada and the Caribbean. Roger Sansom is responsible for operations in the UK, Ireland and Scandinavia.
Herbert Luthy heads up continental and eastern Europe and Latin America. Jean-Michel Chatagny is responsible for Australia, Japan, Korea, the China triangle and south-east Asia.
Martyn Parker assumes control of Africa, Middle East, Israel and India, Cees Waterhout is chief executive of Alhermig, while Stuart McAdam is responsible for finance and product development.
The spokeswoman said no information was available yet on the combined size of the two businesses or the number of staff in the life and health division once the integration is completed.
The division is completely separate from Swiss Re UK and is currently looking for an office building in the central London.

Swiss Re said recently that it will close the M&G office in Cheltenham in south-west England over the next two years as part of its plan to concentrate its operations in London. Up to 360 jobs will be affected.
